+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_HOST = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _coerce_str(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        s = value.strip()
+        return s if s else None
+    return str(value).strip() or None
+
+
+def _coerce_decimal(value):
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)):
+        try:
+            return str(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal("0.01")))
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            return None
+    s = _coerce_str(value)
+    if s is None:
+        return None
+    s = re.sub(r"[^0-9,.-]", "", s)
+    if s.count(",") > 0 and s.count(".") == 0:
+        s = s.replace(",", ".")
+    elif s.count(",") > 0 and s.count(".") > 0:
+        if s.rfind(",") > s.rfind("."):
+            s = s.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
+        else:
+            s = s.replace(",", "")
+    try:
+        return str(Decimal(s).quantize(Decimal("0.01")))
+    except InvalidOperation:
+        return None
+
+
+def _coerce_date(value):
+    s = _coerce_str(value)
+    if s is None:
+        return None
+    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%Y.%m.%d"):
+        try:
+            return datetime.strptime(s, fmt).date().isoformat()
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    try:
+        return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).date().isoformat()
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _normalize_item(item):
+    if not isinstance(item, dict):
+        return {
+            "date": None,
+            "merchant": None,
+            "amount": None,
+            "currency": None,
+            "category": None,
+            "payment_method": None,
+            "tax": None,
+            "tip": None,
+            "notes": None,
+            "source": "openai:gpt-5.4-mini",
+        }
+    currency = _coerce_str(item.get("currency") or item.get("ccy"))
+    if currency:
+        currency = currency.upper()
+    return {
+        "date": _coerce_date(item.get("date") or item.get("transaction_date") or item.get("expense_date")),
+        "merchant": _coerce_str(item.get("merchant") or item.get("vendor") or item.get("payee")),
+        "amount": _coerce_decimal(item.get("amount") or item.get("total") or item.get("value")),
+        "currency": currency,
+        "category": _coerce_str(item.get("category") or item.get("expense_category")),
+        "payment_method": _coerce_str(item.get("payment_method") or item.get("card") or item.get("tender")),
+        "tax": _coerce_decimal(item.get("tax") or item.get("vat") or item.get("sales_tax")),
+        "tip": _coerce_decimal(item.get("tip") or item.get("gratuity")),
+        "notes": _coerce_str(item.get("notes") or item.get("description") or item.get("memo")),
+        "source": "openai:gpt-5.4-mini",
+    }
+
+
+def normalize_expense_fields(payload):
+    if isinstance(payload, list):
+        return [normalize_expense_fields(item) for item in payload]
+    if isinstance(payload, dict) and any(k in payload for k in ("expenses", "items", "records")):
+        key = next(k for k in ("expenses", "items", "records") if k in payload)
+        return {key: [normalize_expense_fields(item) for item in payload.get(key, [])]}
+    return _normalize_item(payload)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Path to JSON input file; reads stdin if omitted")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.input:
+        with open(args.input, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            payload = json.load(f)
+    else:
+        payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
+    result = normalize_expense_fields(payload)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import re
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _read_input(source: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    if source and os.path.isfile(source):
+        with open(source, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return f.read()
+    if source:
+        return source
+    return os.environ.get("INVOICE_TEXT", "")
+
+
+def _build_prompt(text: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        "Extract invoice fields from the text below and return strict JSON with keys "
+        "vendor, date, total, and line_items. line_items must be an array of objects "
+        "with keys description, quantity, unit_price, and amount when available. "
+        "If a field is missing, use null. Return only JSON.\n\n"
+        f"INVOICE TEXT:\n{text}"
+    )
+
+
+def _fallback_parse(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    vendor = None
+    date = None
+    total = None
+    line_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    vendor_match = re.search(r"^(.*?)(?:\n|$)", text.strip())
+    if vendor_match:
+        vendor = vendor_match.group(1).strip() or None
+
+    date_match = re.search(r"\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}|\w+\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4})\b", text)
+    if date_match:
+        date = date_match.group(1)
+
+    total_match = re.search(r"\btotal\b[^\d$€£]*([$€£]?\s?\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d{2})?)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    if total_match:
+        total = total_match.group(1).strip()
+
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if re.search(r"\d", line) and re.search(r"(?:item|qty|price|amount)", line, re.IGNORECASE):
+            line_items.append({"description": line.strip(), "quantity": None, "unit_price": None, "amount": None})
+
+    return {"vendor": vendor, "date": date, "total": total, "line_items": line_items}
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": _build_prompt(text),
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    output_text = ""
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") == "output_text":
+                output_text += content.get("text", "")
+
+    if not output_text:
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+    try:
+        return json.loads(output_text)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", output_text, re.DOTALL)
+        if match:
+            return json.loads(match.group(0))
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    source = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
+    text = _read_input(source)
+    result = extract_invoice_fields(text)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import re
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _read_input(source: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    if source and os.path.isfile(source):
+        with open(source, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return f.read()
+    if source:
+        return source
+    return os.environ.get("INVOICE_TEXT", "")
+
+
+def _build_prompt(text: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        "Extract invoice fields from the text below and return strict JSON with keys "
+        "vendor, date, total, and line_items. line_items must be an array of objects "
+        "with keys description, quantity, unit_price, and amount when available. "
+        "If a field is missing, use null. Return only JSON.\n\n"
+        f"INVOICE TEXT:\n{text}"
+    )
+
+
+def _fallback_parse(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    vendor = None
+    date = None
+    total = None
+    line_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    vendor_match = re.search(r"^(.*?)(?:\n|$)", text.strip())
+    if vendor_match:
+        vendor = vendor_match.group(1).strip() or None
+
+    date_match = re.search(r"\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}|\w+\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4})\b", text)
+    if date_match:
+        date = date_match.group(1)
+
+    total_match = re.search(r"\btotal\b[^\d$€£]*([$€£]?\s?\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d{2})?)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    if total_match:
+        total = total_match.group(1).strip()
+
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if re.search(r"\d", line) and re.search(r"(?:item|qty|price|amount)", line, re.IGNORECASE):
+            line_items.append({"description": line.strip(), "quantity": None, "unit_price": None, "amount": None})
+
+    return {"vendor": vendor, "date": date, "total": total, "line_items": line_items}
+
+
+def extract_invoice_fields(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": _build_prompt(text),
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    output_text = ""
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") == "output_text":
+                output_text += content.get("text", "")
+
+    if not output_text:
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+    try:
+        return json.loads(output_text)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", output_text, re.DOTALL)
+        if match:
+            return json.loads(match.group(0))
+        return _fallback_parse(text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    source = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
+    text = _read_input(source)
+    result = extract_invoice_fields(text)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
